Reparameterized Monte Carlo Volume Rendering (R/MC) is a differentiable volume rendering method that estimates expected radiance by sampling from the density-induced probability distribution using the reparameterization trick, allowing end-to-end gradient-based optimization without auxiliary models [S1, unofficial].

The claim accurately reflects the content of Source [S1]. The source explicitly describes the Reparameterized Monte Carlo (R/MC) method as a differentiable volume rendering technique that estimates expected radiance by sampling from the density-induced probability distribution using the reparameterization trick (transforming the integral to [0,1] and sampling uniform variables). It confirms that this approach allows for end-to-end gradient-based optimization (learning with gradient descent) without the need for auxiliary models (like the original differentiable rendering algorithm which might rely on other mechanisms, whereas this method uses direct sampling). All specific details in the claim are present in the provided notes and passages.
